answer: Cosignatures are collected in sable, verified in saffron, and dune names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 14 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 340 aliases cost 63 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
